effect_description_eng: [Hand] [Main] If you have a Digimon with the [Blue Flare] trait in play, by paying 3 memory, place this card under that Digimon as its bottom digivolution card. Then, unsuspend that Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] While your opponent has 2 or more Digimon in play, this Digimon gets +1000 DP.
